name: Camazotz
entry: Night falls early: the screen darkens, hundreds of bat silhouettes gather above the arena, then one huge shape dives into the centre. 5 s.

abilities.name: Sonic Screech
abilities.effect: 18 dmg, knockback 200, confuses 1 s

abilities.name: Bat Swarm
abilities.effect: summons 6 Cave Bats

abilities.name: Blood Dive
abilities.effect: dash at speed 520, 24 dmg, leaves a blood trail for 3 s (6 dps bleed zone)

abilities.name: Eclipse
abilities.effect: 10 s: only a radius of 280 px around the player is visible; Camazotz eyes glow; bats strike from the dark

abilities.name: Twin Dive
abilities.effect: two simultaneous Blood Dives; speed +15% overall

name: Zipacna
entry: The ground cracks across the whole arena, dust and rocks rise, and Zipacna climbs out of the earth in the centre. 5 s.

abilities.name: Stone Slam
abilities.effect: 26 dmg, knockback 220

abilities.name: Rock Rain
abilities.effect: 8 boulders, 20 dmg each

abilities.name: Fissure Line
abilities.effect: cracks erupt in sequence over 1.2 s, 24 dmg

abilities.name: Stone Armor
abilities.telegraph: 3 glowing heart stones appear (150 HP each)
abilities.effect: Zipacna takes 50% less damage until all 3 are destroyed

abilities.name: Avalanche
abilities.telegraph: dust and shadows at the arena edge
abilities.effect: continuous rockfalls at the edges, 16 dmg

name: Vucub Caquix
entry: A second sun rises over the temple and blinds the screen white for a moment; Vucub Caquix lands in a burst of golden feathers. 6 s.

abilities.name: Sunbeam Sweep
abilities.telegraph: thin line 1 s then a beam 520 x 50
abilities.effect: rotates 180 degrees over 4 s, 20 dmg per 0.3 s of contact

abilities.name: Feather Barrage
abilities.effect: fan of 9 feathers, speed 260, 12 dmg

abilities.name: Solar Flare Rings
abilities.effect: 3 expanding rings with 2 safe gaps each, 20 dmg

abilities.name: Second Sun
abilities.effect: orbs (80 HP each, shootable) launch slowly homing, 22 dmg; destroying them stuns the boss 1.5 s

abilities.name: Zenith
abilities.telegraph: boss flies up (invulnerable), sunbeams mark the player trail 4 s, then a 1.2 s circle r 200
abilities.effect: crashes down: 34 dmg

name: Ah Puch
entry: The underworld gate opens in the arena floor, green light climbs the sky, music drops to a drone, and a skeletal lord rises with a slow voice. 8 s, longest entrance.

abilities.name: Death Gaze
abilities.effect: laser 520 long, 28 dmg per 0.3 s tick for 1 s

abilities.name: Bone Spear Ring
abilities.effect: 12 spears erupt, then a second ring offset by half a step, 20 dmg each

abilities.name: Soul Drain
abilities.effect: pulls the player 2 s, 10 dmg and heals the boss

abilities.name: Summon Lords
abilities.effect: summons 2 elite Hollow Priests

abilities.name: Xibalba Shift
abilities.effect: fog fills the arena (8 dps outside light); 4 safe light circles r 120 move every 15 s

abilities.name: Final Rite
abilities.effect: blast 80 dmg to anyone outside the circles; first one 6 s into the phase, then every 20 s; boss speed +25%
